hotspots.title: a photo of maya
hotspots.back:
a sticky note on the back, in maya's hand:

lab acct if you need the big printer —
   kpatel / okafor99
don't tell kav i gave you this.  — m.

subtitle.text: yo, it's greg. what the hell just HAPPENED?
the whole grid just died, dude. i think this is it. this is the end.
thank god her dad's got a backup generator.
i have no idea what's going on.
i think the hot girl at the bar is looking at me.
(away from the phone) hey... so. you ever heard of ROI?
it's radio, but over the inter—
yo, it's me. get on DSN.

hotspots.title: your y2k checklist
hotspots.note:
water (6 gal) ✓
canned stuff ✓
batteries ✓
cash — $200
backup floppies ✓
print phone #s ✓
call maya

the two you didn't tick are the two that cost something.

hotspots.title: a sticky note
hotspots.note:
pay phone bill!!

the wardialing was not free. the bell is going to notice.

hotspots.title: a sticky note
hotspots.note:
ziggy's bday

you missed it. it was in october.

hotspots.title: a sticky note
hotspots.note:
DONT reboot

not until the scan finishes. it finished on the 27th. the note stayed.

hotspots.title: 2400: the hacker quarterly — winter 1999
hotspots.back:
COVER: "Ghost exchanges: the maintenance lines your phone company forgot"  — p.14

someone circled p.14 twice.

hotspots.title: your pager
hotspots.note:
LAST PAGE 23:35. sixteen digits, still crawling across the glass.

nobody you know has a number that long.

idle.title: your pager
idle.note:
NO PAGES.

quiet night. everyone you'd page is at a party.

hotspots.title: a bobblehead of the president
hotspots.note:
a gag gift from maya. it nods at everything you say.

it has been nodding since '96.

hotspots.title: your tape
hotspots.note:
Y2K SURVIVAL MIX. maya made it for you in december. her handwriting on the label, her hearts in the margins.

"all your loud boys on one tape. the punk, the rock, the metal you swear helps you think. play it when the world ends. — m."
hotspots.back:
side a
  enter sandman — metallica
  killing in the name — rage against the machine
  basket case — green day
  master of puppets — metallica

side b
  bulls on parade — rage against the machine
  longview — green day
  guerrilla radio — rage against the machine
  carousel — hybrid theory

she circled the last one twice:
  "new band?? demo tape. trust me."
